items.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    The late Neolithic period in China was marked by an intensification of social complexity and stratification, with the emergence of human sacrifices being a crucial manifestation. Among prehistoric China, Qingliangsi site has yielded the largest number of sacrificial burials to date. The origins of the victims have been a subject of debate, mainly framed as an intracommunity versus intercommunity issue. However, due to limited evidence, this matter remains controversial. This study conducts integrated analyses of ancient DNA and stable carbon and nitrogen isotopes and strontium isotopes on four individuals from the representative tomb M356 (one tomb owner and three human sacrifices). Our results indicate genetic affinity among the four individuals from M356, which can be modeled as approximately 85.8%–90.0% YR_MN and about 10.0%–14.2% ANA‐related ancestry. Strontium isotope results show that one human sacrifice exhibits a strontium isotope value above the local baseline, suggesting this individual was likely a nonlocal migrant. Additionally, when integrated with previously published data, the stable isotope results show distinct group differences: the tomb owner, buried with the victims, consumed significantly more animal protein than both the human sacrifices and the owners of single burials (H (2) = 14.696,
                    <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>
                     = 0.001 < 0.05). Furthermore, the unusual carbon isotope values among a small number of sacrificial individuals imply that they might have come from distant intercommunity regions, such as the Huai River Basin, where mixed millet–rice agriculture was practiced. These findings suggest that the large‐scale human sacrifices at Qingliangsi site were primarily sustained by internal social stratification, while also reflecting limited broader regional interactions.
                  </jats:p>
items.summary: 《中国中黄河流域新石器时代晚期人祭墓葬的遗传、饮食与地理来源：来自清凉寺遗址的证据》：研究对清凉寺遗址M356号墓的墓主与三名人牲进行古DNA及碳氮稳定同位素、锶同位素综合分析，发现四者存在遗传亲缘关系，其中一名人牲锶同位素值高于当地基线、可能为非本地移民，墓主摄入的动物蛋白显著多于人牲及单人葬墓主，少数人牲的异常碳同位素值提示其可能来自淮河流域等粟稻混作…
items.title: Genetics, Diet, and Geographic Origins of Late Neolithic Human Sacrificial Tombs in the Middle Yellow River Valley: Evidence From the Qingliangsi Site, China

items.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    Estuarine ecosystems provide important connections for biogeochemical processes like carbon transfer between terrestrial, freshwater and marine environments. This study investigates the role of ground‐dwelling carabid beetles as potential mediators of aquatic carbon flow across the salinity gradient of the Elbe estuary in northern Germany. We analysed stable isotope signatures (carbon δ
                    <jats:sup>13</jats:sup>
                    C and nitrogen δ
                    <jats:sup>15</jats:sup>
                    N) of four carabid beetle species, along with local baseline samples of plants, soil and invertebrate bulk bycatch, to study the integration and transfer of aquatic‐derived resources in these ecotones. While baseline signatures differed significantly between freshwater and saltwater marshes, beetle δ
                    <jats:sup>13</jats:sup>
                    C signatures, corrected for habitat baselines, revealed species‐specific patterns influenced by their opportunistic foraging behaviours and local prey availability. Beetle δ
                    <jats:sup>13</jats:sup>
                    C values showed no significant change with distance from the riverbank in any species (one‐way ANOVAs by species:
                    <jats:styled-content style="fixed-case">
                      <jats:italic>L. assimilis</jats:italic>
                    </jats:styled-content>
                    <jats:italic>F</jats:italic>
                    <jats:sub>2,47</jats:sub>
                     = 1.64,
                    <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>
                     = 0.21;
                    <jats:styled-content style="fixed-case">
                      <jats:italic>P. niger</jats:italic>
                    </jats:styled-content>
                    <jats:italic>F</jats:italic>
                    <jats:sub>2,46</jats:sub>
                     = 1.66,
                    <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>
                     = 0.20;
                    <jats:styled-content style="fixed-case">
                      <jats:italic>C. auratus</jats:italic>
                    </jats:styled-content>
                    <jats:italic>F</jats:italic>
                    <jats:sub>2,47</jats:sub>
                     = 2.05,
                    <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>
                     = 0.14;
                    <jats:styled-content style="fixed-case">
                      <jats:italic>D. globosus</jats:italic>
                    </jats:styled-content>
                    <jats:italic>F</jats:italic>
                    <jats:sub>2,47</jats:sub>
                     = 0.80,
                    <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>
                     = 0.46), indicating remarkable stability of aquatic carbon signatures across the marsh width. Yet, isotopic niches varied substantially among species and habitats, indicating differences in resource use. Our findings suggest that carabid beetles predominantly act as local processors of already integrated carbon sources at lower trophic levels, rather than as carriers directly transporting aquatic carbon into terrestrial food webs. This study highlights the importance of understanding consumer‐mediated carbon fluxes and underscores the need for further detailed, seasonally resolved isotopic studies to improve predictions of estuarine ecosystem responses to ongoing environmental change, including sea‐level rise and hydrological shifts. Recognising carabids as habitat‐specific and opportunistic processors offers a better framework for understanding their role in complex biogeochemical dynamics shaping estuarine ecosystems.
                  </jats:p>
items.summary: 《步甲作为河口生态系统中的局部碳中介》：该研究以德国北部易北河河口盐度梯度上的四种步甲为对象，结合碳、氮稳定同位素与植物、土壤及无脊椎动物基线样本，考察水生来源碳在陆生食物网中的整合与传递；结果显示步甲更可能是低营养级已整合碳源的局部加工者，而非将水生碳直接带入陆生食物网的载体，值得关注河口碳通量与消费者介导过程的研究者阅读。
items.title: Carabid Beetles as Local Carbon Mediators in Estuarine Ecosystems

items.summary: 《末次冰消期以来中国北方季风边缘区的火历史及其驱动机制》：该研究探讨末次冰消期以来中国北方季风边缘区的火历史与驱动机制，值得关注区域古环境演变与火活动关系的读者阅读。
items.title: Fire history and driving mechanisms in the monsoon marginal zone of northern China since the last deglaciation

items.summary: 《逝者的牛奶与葡萄酒：铁器时代晚期梅诺卡岛的丧葬习俗——以卡莱斯科维斯45号庭院为例》：该研究以卡莱斯科维斯45号庭院为个案，考察铁器时代晚期梅诺卡岛的丧葬习俗，值得关注。
